title: Set CRON_ENDPOINT as a GitHub repository variable
body: Add CRON_ENDPOINT as a repository variable in GitHub Settings > Variables > Actions. It should point to the production app URL (e.g., the Vercel deployment URL). This is required for the media-cleanup workflow to pass. The code fix (vars.CRON_ENDPOINT) is already committed in 705acaf3c.
rationale: The workflow guard check exits with code 1 if CRON_ENDPOINT is unset. The code fix is already committed — once the repository variable is configured, the workflow will succeed.
